title: Critique: maxima of integrated information cannot be computed for brains

statements.text: The claim that the posterior hot zone is a maximum of integrated information is purely theoretical, since the computations needed to identify maximal complexes are intractable for biological systems and it is contested which estimates are valid. Claims that tie SOHMs to such maxima share this gap.

sources.quote: This stipulation is currently purely theoretical, as the computations required to formally identify maximal complexes are intractable for biological systems
